task: Roles (admin/manager/viewer) + admin user management, server-side upload job queue with live progress (reload-safe), signup auto-login, search sorts + A-Z alphabet tabs + numbered pagination (max 15/page), duplicate-upload dedup (PDF hash + listing key), bilingual company names, and per-file upload controls (pause/resume/cancel/restart/remove) with per-file animated progress

upload_controls.why: User wanted per-file control while files upload, plus per-file loading (not one global bar).
upload_controls.controls: pause (queued->paused), resume (paused->queued), cancel (queued/paused/processing->cancelled), restart (failed/cancelled->queued, re-runs), remove (drop from list). Server sends can_pause/can_resume/can_cancel/can_restart/can_remove per job so the UI shows only valid buttons.
upload_controls.limitation: A processing file's AI call can't be interrupted; cancel drops its result and stops saving more products (already-saved products remain, they're valid). Pause only applies to files still queued.
upload_controls.worker: jobs.py rewritten from asyncio.Queue to a scan-based loop + wake Event so a waiting job's state can change (pause/cancel). Statuses: queued|processing|paused|done|failed|cancelled.
upload_controls.restart: PDF bytes kept for failed/cancelled jobs (dropped on success/removal) so restart re-runs without re-upload; idempotent via the listing dedup key.
upload_controls.frontend: UploadJobRow.tsx: per-file animated 'fake' progress bar (queued -> creeps during extraction -> tracks 'saving product i/N' -> 100%, colored by status) + lucide icon buttons per can_* flags. UploadQueue renders one row per job + optimistic 'Uploading...' placeholders during the client POST.

dedup.why: Re-uploading the same brochure (same or different filename) created duplicate listings and re-ran the full AI+PubChem+fuzzy pipeline each time.
dedup.level_1_pdf_hash: SHA-256 of PDF bytes stored in the new 'documents' table. jobs.enqueue() short-circuits an identical re-upload (or a same-batch duplicate via an in-memory in-flight hash set) to a done job with duplicate=true — no AI call, no inserts. Content-based, so renamed copies are caught.
dedup.level_2_listing_key: listings.dedup_key = company_id|name_raw(lower,trim)|price|currency|purity, UNIQUE index, insert_listing upserts on it. Keyed on name_raw NOT chemical_id (the fuzzy matcher over-merges distinct grades onto one chemical_id — keying on it would delete real products). company_id is in the key, so the SAME chemical from DIFFERENT suppliers stays as separate listings.
dedup.bilingual_company: companies.company_name_en added; extraction returns company_name (as printed) + company_name_en; resolve_company matches on either name (case-insensitive), backfills English, matches in Python to tolerate commas/parens in supplier names.
dedup.chemical_resolution: CAS-first flow (dedup.py, part 3): CAS present -> match on CAS ONLY, else create new (name never consulted, so a CAS-bearing product never fuzzy-merges); no CAS -> exact English name reuse, else fuzzy token_sort_ratio>=97 (flagged needs_review), else create new. PubChem lookup removed. Fixes the part-2 over-merge and raises the threshold from 90 to 97.

roles.note: New signups default to 'viewer' — the LIVE handle_new_user trigger has always inserted 'viewer' (earlier docs claiming 'admin' were wrong; db/schema.sql corrected 2026-07-16). Promote via /admin/users; an admin cannot change their OWN role (backend returns 400).

Params: q, cas, min_price, max_price (USD — compared against normalized price_usd), min_purity, max_purity, details_q (loose JSONB match), priced_only, sort (price sorts order by price_usd, nulls LAST), letter (a-z), page, page_size (max 15). api_surface.PATCH /listings/{id}: auth: admin|manager (widened 2026-07-19). api_surface.POST /listings/bulk-delete: auth: admin|manager (widened 2026-07-19). Body {ids: [uuid, ...]} (1-200). Deletes the set in one .in_() call; unknown ids skipped. Returns {interpreted_filters, count, page, page_size, total_pages, results}. LLM/parse failure -> 502.

api_surface.POST /upload-jobs: auth: admin|manager. Enqueue one PDF (validated: MIME, %PDF- magic, size). Returns the job (202).
api_surface.GET /upload-jobs: auth: admin|manager. Caller's jobs with live stage text + can_* control flags — polling this is how the UI shows per-file progress and survives reloads.
api_surface.POST /upload-jobs/clear-finished: auth: admin|manager. Remove caller's done/failed/cancelled jobs.
api_surface.POST /upload-jobs/{id}/action: auth: admin|manager. Body {action: pause|resume|cancel|restart|remove}. Per-file control. Returns {job} or {removed:true}. 400 on invalid action for the job's state.

gotchas: Supabase edge for this project throws Cloudflare error 1101 ('Worker threw exception') when a bare .ilike() filter contains a literal '%'. Use PostgREST's '*' wildcard alias instead (.ilike('name_en', 'a*')). '%' inside .or_() strings works fine.

uvicorn --reload (WatchFiles) is unreliable on this Windows machine: it detects the first change then silently keeps serving OLD code. Run without --reload and restart the backend manually after edits.

PostgREST embedded joins (companies(company_name)) return a nested object — flatten before Pydantic validation (_flatten_company). The listings.company_id -> companies.id FK must exist for the embed to resolve.
Do not use 'from __future__ import annotations' in FastAPI routers with UploadFile params.

The upload job queue and the _inflight_hashes dedup set are in-memory: a backend restart clears them (the persistent 'documents' ledger still prevents cross-restart duplicates). Persist the queue to a DB table if that ever matters.
min_purity is filtered in Python AFTER pagination, so a page may show slightly fewer than 15 rows when it drops entries.
Listing dedup MUST key on name_raw, not chemical_id: the fuzzy matcher merges distinct product grades onto one chemical_id, so a chemical_id-based key would drop real products.
_normalize_price (Python) and the SQL dedup_key backfill must stay in lockstep (both strip trailing zeros/point) or re-uploaded priced rows won't match. Verified equal against a live row.
resolve_company matches in Python (not a PostgREST filter) because supplier names contain commas/parentheses that break .or_() filter strings.

The password-reset redirect URL (<origin>/reset-password) must be allowlisted in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication -> URL Configuration -> Redirect URLs). Dashboard-only config — no SQL/migration/env var can set it.

'from __future__ import annotations' in a router combined with slowapi's @limiter.limit decorator makes FastAPI treat a pydantic BODY model as a QUERY param (422 'Field required' in query). Same family as the UploadFile gotcha — never use future-annotations in routers.

The pinned postgrest-py's .order(nullsfirst=False) silently DROPS the modifier (it only ever emits .nullsfirst) — and Postgres defaults to NULLS FIRST for DESC, so price_desc showed all unpriced rows first. database._order_nulls_last() writes the order query param explicitly; use it for any nullable-column sort.

min_price/max_price are USD bounds compared against price_usd, NOT the raw mixed-currency price column. Extraction writes currency strings like 'Yuan/ton' — rates.normalize_currency() parses the token before '/'.

Listings extracted before part 10 have details=null and no company_website; their PDFs are content-hash-deduped so a re-upload will NOT re-extract them. Backfill requires a re-process feature (roadmap).
